sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United face Alsager Town at home on Saturday. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and will be favoured against struggling Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a match between mid-table sides, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a clash involving two teams with strong recent form. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a meeting of sides separated by just 6 points. In-form Bilston Town are at home to Foley Meir, with both teams showing positive recent records. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement-battle between two of the division's struggling sides. Market Drayton Town host New Mills as both teams look to climb out of mid-table, while Crewe face Allscott Heath at home in a clash of lower-ranked teams. Shawbury United host Barnton, with the latter's recent win suggesting they may pose a threat to the hosts' poor recent form. Finally, Brereton Social play host to Widnes Town, with the visitors' desperate situation (bottom of the table, pointless from seven games) making them heavy underdogs.
